scroll.welcomemessage.1:
Welcome, mighty heroes!

The evil mage Garm has broken into
my Tower and used the Runestones
to summon the demon Skorne.

Skorne broke free from Garm's control
and destroyed him.
scroll.welcomemessage.2:
Skorne has unleashed his minions upon
the land and scattered the Runestones
across the Eight Realms. Now he has
sealed himself in the Desecrated Temple.

The entrance is protected by eight
magical Shards. Each is in the possession
of one of Skorne's mighty Guardians.
scroll.welcomemessage.3:
You must travel to each of the
Eight Realms, fight your way
through Skorne's minions,
and defeat his Guardians.

Only after obtaining all eight shards
can you enter the Desecrated Temple
and banish Skorne to the Underworld.
scroll.welcomemessage.4:
Skorne has sealed the entrance to each
realm with a magical shield. Throughout
the land you will find Crystals which
will enable you to remove these shields.
scroll.welcomemessage.5:
I have summoned to my tower enough
Crystals to unlock one of the
Eight Realms, the Forsaken Province.

Go now, the fate of the Realms
is in your hands!
scroll.garmmessage.1:
The spirit of Garm has absorbed the
essence of Skorne and now seeks to
destroy us. His undead armies have
surrounded my Tower and are attacking
even now.

Lost somewhere among the battlefields
lies the Thirteenth Runestone. With
it you can gain entrance to Garm's
Citadel.
scroll.garmmessage.2:
Go now and seek this final Runestone.
Once you have found it, enter Garm's
Citadel and face him in one final
confrontation. The outcome of that
battle will decide the fate of
the realm!
scroll.demowelcome.1:
Welcome to the Gauntlet Dark Legacy Demo!

This tower contains portals to many
worlds. One of them is open for you
to play through. Look for the glowing
portal forward and to your left.

If you explore the rest of this tower,
you will catch a glimpse of what the
many other worlds in Gauntlet are like.
scroll.demolevel.1:
For the purpose of this Demo,
Your level has been changed
scroll.democlosed.1:
This Realm is not available
in this Demo.
scroll.scrollsa1.1: Water holds passage to your dreams.
scroll.scrollsa1.2:
Go forward and return,
you will be rewarded.
scroll.scrollsa1.3:
You must release the golem
to reach the exit.
scroll.scrollsa1.4:
You must unlock the gate ahead
to reach the exit.
scroll.scrollsa2.1:
Death awaits you
in the shower.
scroll.scrollsa2.2:
The General is not here
to satisfy his hunger.
scroll.scrollsa2.3:
Death fears what is hidden
in one of the grunt lockers.
scroll.scrollsa2.4:
A hero who wields this Ice Axe
should now challenge the Dragon.
scroll.scrollsa3.3:
If you do not find a Runestone
starting fresh is easier
than walking back.
scroll.scrollsa4.1:
There is treasure ahead
worth fighting for.
scroll.scrollsa4.2:
Using the transporters first
will lead to greater wealth.
scroll.scrollsa4.3:
Fighting the three headed beast
before entering the Forest Realm
is certain death.
scroll.scrollsa6.1:
A Gargoyle is guarding
access to much gold.
scroll.scrollsa6.2:
Retrace your steps
and be rewarded by a dead man.
scroll.scrollsb1.1:
Don't forget to explore
the lower waterfall.
scroll.scrollsb2.1:
Only open gates
that you need to.
scroll.scrollsb3.1:
Before opening gates,
look for alternate paths.
scroll.scrollsb3.2:
Generals guard triggers to unlock
that which Sumner requires!
scroll.scrollsb4.1: X-Ray glasses will serve you well.
scroll.scrollsb4.2:
There are enough keys
to open all good chests.
scroll.scrollsb5.1:
If you retrieve the golden fangs
you can get the legend item.
scroll.scrollsb5.2:
Without entering the Castle Realm
slaying the Dragon
will prove to be difficult.
scroll.scrollsc1.1:
Valuables were often kept in the walls
in times of war.
scroll.scrollsc2.1:
Forward leads to health
and happiness.
Right leads to wealth
and power.
scroll.scrollsc2.2:
The path to your dreams is buried
within the arena walls.
scroll.scrollsc2.3:
Unworthy offerings
are cast upon the steps.
scroll.scrollsc3.1:
Where a golem guards white crystals,
a trigger can bring wealth.
scroll.scrollsc3.3:
Near the claw is hidden
an item of legend.
scroll.scrollsc3.4:
Use these Bellows
to poison the Spider Queen.
scroll.scrollsc4.1:
Where water flows
one will find the key
to wealth and danger.
scroll.scrollsc4.2:
Look around the
crystal laden altar of flames
to continue on your quest.
scroll.scrollsc4.3:
A spitting cobra can bring
great wealth and power.
scroll.scrollsc4.4:
Do not pass through this gate too soon.
Much can be lost.
scroll.scrollsc4.5:
The Desert Guardian
fears only the
Lamp of Dark Obstruction.
scroll.scrollsd1.1:
Journey past from where you came
touch the trigger
all will not be the same.
scroll.scrollsd1.2:
Hasten not from here,
great bounty is unseen.
scroll.scrollsd2.1:
On the pathways ahead
choose carefully what you unlock.
scroll.scrollsd2.2: Search carefully at the next bend.
scroll.scrollsd3.1:
A fearsome beast guards
the archer's secret form.
scroll.scrollsd4.1:
Trouble lies ahead for those
who find their key ring empty.
scroll.scrollsd4.2:
Pale crystals and fierce generals
mark an ancient and sacred hollow.
scroll.scrollsd4.3:
Do not leave until the
vicious beast has been slain.
scroll.scrollsd4.4:
This weapon will ease your task
of slaying the Castle Chimera.
scroll.scrollse1.1:
To see or not to see,
time is the question.
scroll.scrollse1.2:
He who hoards his potions
may grow weaker.
scroll.scrollsg1.1:
Past the mill is a
well guarded vault.
scroll.scrollsg1.2:
The path ahead
is laden with traps
for the greedy.
scroll.scrollsg1.3:
Death awaits those who try to pass,
prepare yourself!
scroll.scrollsg1.4:
Do not pass through this gate
until you find two switches.
scroll.scrollsg2.1:
Not all food can be found
at ground level.
scroll.scrollsg2.2:
Death to those who dare
steal from the hangman.
scroll.scrollsg2.3:
There is more than
bats in the belfry.
scroll.scrollsg3.2:
This gate can be opened
from the farthest corner.
scroll.scrollsg3.3:
The rich foolishly try
to take their wealth with them.
scroll.scrollsg3.4:
When the righteous choose right
wealth comes their way.
scroll.scrollsg3.5:
Behind a tomb you will find
the key to the exit.
scroll.scrollsg4.1:
You may need to go back
if you wish to proceed.
scroll.scrollsg4.2:
On the altar much has been given
to honor Skorne.
scroll.scrollsg4.3:
Beware of treasures
found with ease.
scroll.scrollsg4.4:
Great bounty can be found
within the hallowed chapel.
scroll.scrollsg4.5:
Only a fool would face the Lich
without the Good Book.
scroll.scrollsh1.1:
Sometimes the long way
is the best way.
scroll.scrollsh1.2:
Near the end, many soldiers
will trade their lives for yours.
scroll.scrollsh1.3:
Shooting barrels
will destroy
the meal deal.
scroll.scrollsh2.1: Death awaits you around the next bend.
scroll.scrollsh2.2:
You may fight one or three
before you reach the exit.
scroll.scrollsh2.3:
If this golem cage is up
then you are in for a tough fight.
scroll.scrollsh2.5: Did you find the egg and ham?
scroll.scrollsh3.2:
You do not need to venture far
to continue your journey.
scroll.scrollsh3.3:
The path ahead is locked
from the pit below.
scroll.scrollsh3.4:
Get Death to leave his post
and good fortune may be yours.
scroll.scrollsh3.5: Beyond the gate the exit is sealed.
scroll.scrollsh3.6:
If you can find
a breakable wall nearby
your ultimate goal is in reach.
scroll.scrollsi1.2:
Do not take this passage
until the tower floor
has been raised.
scroll.scrollsi1.3:
He who saves a key till the
exit shall be rewarded.
scroll.scrollsi1.4:
Wait for mine car
then quickly follow.
scroll.scrollsi2.1: You are on the right track.
scroll.scrollsi2.2:
This area contains a
five piece puzzle.
scroll.scrollsi2.3:
A red light will not lead you
to your goal.
scroll.scrollsi3.1: A General waits for you in the pit.
scroll.scrollsi3.2:
Tubs of ore would be wise
to explore.
scroll.scrollsi3.3:
To melt the ice
find some fire.
scroll.scrollsi3.4:
Crystals will lead you
to the golden pond.
scroll.scrollsi3.5:
Trek through shallow water
before the exit can be reached.
scroll.scrollsi4.3:
There is more here
than one can see.
scroll.scrollsi4.4:
If you are stopped,
retreat to the flowing lava.
scroll.scrollsi4.5:
This Lamp will severely
blind the terrible Genie.
scroll.scrollsj1.1:
Health will be lost
if you spin the wheel too soon.
scroll.scrollsj2.1:
Shadowy dreams fade away
when forced into the light.
scroll.scrollsj2.2:
Great tribute has been paid
to the fallen heroes of the realms.
scroll.scrollsj2.3:
A mighty general
guards the only way forward.
scroll.scrollsj3.1:
Once you pass this hallway
you are trapped on the second floor.
scroll.scrollsj3.2:
The organ must play to
get to the upper floor.
scroll.scrollsj3.3:
The trick to unlocking magic
lies in a bookshelf.
scroll.scrollsj3.4:
Let the light lead
you to your bed.
scroll.scrollsj4.1:
When all players move forward,
none may return.
scroll.scrollsj4.2:
Dare to walk where
no path is found.
scroll.scrollsj4.3:
Continue forward
only with Runestone in hand.
scroll.scrollsj6.1:
Treasure is not the only gold
you will find nearby.
scroll.scrollsj6.2:
You should not always take
the first bridge you come to.
scroll.scrollsj6.3:
At the heart of the world
a Runestone may be found.
scroll.scrollsj6.4:
Do not touch the tongue
unless you are an angel.
scroll.scrollsk1.1:
Two begin to free
in steps of three
five must be
the center key.
scroll.scrollsk1.2:
Prepare yourself well!
Two mighty beasts dwell within
the ships massive hold.
scroll.scrollsk1.3:
From where a dead man hangs,
a lone pale crystal sits.
scroll.scrollsk1.4:
When you reach four switches
one will lead you astray.
scroll.scrollsk1.5:
The Plague Fiend is no match
for a hero with the Javelin.
scroll.scrollsk2.1:
Check well the lookout tower,
for it holds items you need.
scroll.scrollsk2.2: Items left behind are forever lost.
scroll.scrollsk2.3:
Do not venture far until you
have seen the secret exit.
scroll.scrollsk2.4:
Your ticket to ride
is a one way trip.
scroll.scrollsk3.1:
A meal can distract you
from a higher goal.
scroll.scrollsk3.2: Venture further and you can not return.
scroll.scrollsk3.3:
Continue on this path
and you will leave the past behind.
scroll.scrollsk4.1: Do not let these gems pass you by.
scroll.scrollsk4.2:
Do not jump ship until
you find the bounty.
scroll.scrollsk4.3:
You must first reach the exit
to obtain the book of protection.
scroll.scrollsk4.4:
Use this holy book
to help defeat the Lich.
hint.chimerahints.1:
The Scimitar of Decapitation
can be found in the Forest Realm
and will remove the Chimera's lion head.
hint.chimerahints.2:
Prior to fighting this beast
purchase if you can
a reflective shield and a three way shot.
hint.chimerahints.3:
A wise method of attack is to
eliminate an outer head and continue
attacking from that side.
hint.dragonhints.1:
The Legendary Ice Axe
which has been hidden in the Castle Realm
can be used to freeze the Dragon's fiery heart.
hint.dragonhints.2:
You should practice your block skill
before facing the mighty Dragon.
hint.dragonhints.3:
Use well the protective rocks
scattered around the Dragon's lair.
hint.djinnhints.1:
The Lamp of Dark Obstruction
has been lost somewhere in the Ice Domain
and when used will blind the mighty Genie.
hint.djinnhints.2:
The Genie's powers of defense
are weakest when matched against
the forces of the electric amulet.
hint.djinnhints.3:
Avoid the deadly eye beam
by moving in close
and circling to the right.
hint.driderhints.1:
The Toxic Bellows found in the
Desert Pyramid shrinks the Spider Queen
and turns her green with envy.
hint.driderhints.2:
The Spider Queen is vulnerable to
acid attacks and her offspring
are no match for levitation.
hint.driderhints.3:
Her only defense from behind
is a vicious kick.
Exploit this weakness.
hint.plaguehints.1:
The Javelin of Blinding
can be found in the Mountain Realm
and will spear the Plague Fiend's only eye.
hint.plaguehints.2:
Pelting this beast
with super shots
will make your task easier.
hint.plaguehints.3:
There are no safe spots
in the Fiend's chamber.
Blocking is the key to survival.
hint.yetihints.1:
In the Forsaken Province you can find the
Parchment of Fire whose roaring flames will
protect you from many of the Yeti's attacks.
hint.yetihints.2:
Fire is the most feared magic
of all ice creatures.
hint.yetihints.3:
After the Yeti summons
shards of ice from below,
use them to your advantage.
hint.wraithhints.1:
The Dream Realm holds the Lantern
of Revelation whose light will repel
many of the Wraith's shadowy attacks.
hint.wraithhints.2:
The light amulet's power
is greatest when facing
the evils of the Wraith.
hint.wraithhints.3:
The Wraith's many dark attacks
are best blocked rather than avoided.
hint.lichhints.1:
The Book of Protection
which is found in the Sky Realm
severely burns the Lich with its holy light.
hint.lichhints.2:
Firing rapidly while the Lich
emerges from the ground
will quicken his demise.
hint.lichhints.3:
A well timed charge when the Lich leaps
towards you will keep you a good distance
from many of his attacks.
hint.skorne1hints.1:
The Soul Savior is found in the
Desecrated Temple and drains the power
from many of Skorne's attacks.
hint.skorne1hints.2:
You must face Skorne without the aid
of buying powerups, so enter the Temple with
full health and many potions.
hint.skorne1hints.3:
Once Skorne is defeated,
quickly pick one of his weapons
to help you through the Underworld.
hint.skorne2hints.1:
There is no legend item that
can assist you in this battle.
hint.skorne2hints.2:
Your remaining health from the Underworld
is your only hope in defeating Skorne.
hint.skorne2hints.3:
Only a Hero
who has mastered all fighting techniques
will survive at Skorne's Throne.
hint.garmhints.1:
After this final battle
you will have no need for gold
so arm yourself as best you can.
hint.garmhints.2:
From a distance concentrate on
destroying Garm's powerful arms.
hint.garmhints.3:
Once weakened,
move in close to finish him.
hint.nobosshint.1:
I have no advice for you
at this time.
hint.rune1hints.1:
The only Runestone
to reach the Castle Realm
has landed in a well guarded place.
hint.rune1hints.2:
In the Armory you will find
the Runestone where dripping meat
awaits the boiling cauldron.
hint.rune1hints.3:
Find the black crystal
and it will lead you to the Runestone.
hint.rune2hints.1:
The Sky Realm holds two Runestones
and both can be found after the Spire.
hint.rune2hints.2:
The Sky Docks hold the first Runestone
which can be found after taking
two flying platform rides.
hint.rune2hints.3:
The large geared flying ship
holds this Runestone in a steel cage.
hint.rune3hints.1:
The second Runestone in the Sky Realm
is well hidden within the Mothership.
hint.rune3hints.2:
You must reach Mothership's bow
to access the Runestone location.
hint.rune3hints.3:
There is more than one combination
to solve this puzzle.
A three switch combination
will also lead to a meal.
hint.rune4hints.1:
The only Runestone
to reach the Mountain Realm
is hidden by a veil of water.
hint.rune4hints.2:
In the Valley of Fire
the Runestone stays drenched
until you touch it.
hint.rune4hints.3:
You must find the white crystal
to gain access to the Runestone.
hint.rune5hints.1:
Two Runestones are in the Ice Realm
past the Arctic Docks.
hint.rune5hints.2:
The first Runestone is encased
atop the mechanical tower
in the Frozen Camp.
hint.rune5hints.3:
A Gargoyle guards
the first of five triggers.
hint.rune6hints.1:
The last Runestone to be scattered
has landed inside the Crystal Mine
of the Ice Realm
hint.rune6hints.2:
Find the semi frozen waterfall
to locate the Runestone.
hint.rune6hints.3:
find three triggers
Steam, Pit and Ore.
hint.rune7hints.1:
The only Runestone in the Desert Realm
has taken hiding in the City Ruins.
hint.rune7hints.2:
Look for markings on upper level walls
to lead you to the Runestone.
hint.rune7hints.3:
You must pass the Gargoyle
to gain access to the Runestone.
hint.rune8hints.1:
The Poisoned Fields
hold the first of two Runestones
which landed in the Forsaken Province.
hint.rune8hints.2:
You must travel beyond the windmill
to find the Runestone.
hint.rune8hints.3:
If you reach the river mill
you have gone too far.
hint.rune9hints.1:
The second Runestone
in the Forsaken Province
is hidden in the Mausoleum.
hint.rune9hints.2:
You must first lower
the marble tile bridge
which holds five red crystals.
hint.rune9hints.3:
A hidden Death
guards access to this Runestone.
hint.rune10hints.1:
The only Runestone to reach the Forest
is kept in the Twisted Roots of Evil.
hint.rune10hints.2:
An elevator raises you to the path
which leads to the Runestone.
hint.rune10hints.3:
Death and a Golem guard the Runestone
you are searching for.
hint.rune11hints.1:
The first of two Runestones
located in the Dream Realm
is in Your Worst Nightmare.
hint.rune11hints.2:
Ride up on the pumping heart piston
to gain access to the Runestone.
hint.rune11hints.3:
A Gargoyle guards all access
to this heart piston.
hint.rune12hints.1:
The last Dream Runestone can be found
in the Maze of Illusion.
hint.rune12hints.2:
The Runestone may be viewed early
but not obtained until later.
hint.rune12hints.3:
Lower a tower near the fountain
but don't leave this area
until you have acquired the Runestone.
hint.rune13hints.1:
The only Runestone
that reached the Battlefield Realm
is located in the Fortress.
hint.rune13hints.2:
If teleporters have been seen
you have gone too far.
hint.chimeralhints.1:
The Scimitar of Decapitation
can be found in the Gnarled Branches.
hint.chimeralhints.2:
The first pair of white crystals
mark the resting spot
for this legendary item.
hint.chimeralhints.3:
Locate the trigger by the spiral stairs
to gain access to the Scimitar.
hint.dragonlhints.1:
The Legendary Ice Axe can be found
in the Castle Barracks.
hint.dragonlhints.2:
You must pass the stables
and enter the mess hall
to obtain the Ice Axe.
hint.dragonlhints.3:
If you can obtain
the golden feather
you can find the Ice Axe.
hint.djinnlhints.1:
The Lamp of Dark Obstruction can be
obtained from the Erupting Fissure
in the Ice Domain.
hint.djinnlhints.2:
A Gargoyle guards the locked
and hidden entrance to the
cave where the lamp can be found.
hint.djinnlhints.3:
You must obtain the golden claw
to gain access to the lamp.
hint.driderlhints.1:
The Toxic Bellows can be found
deep within the Desert Pyramid.
hint.driderlhints.2:
Locked away in a sacred chamber
you will find a sarcophagus
that holds the Toxic Bellows.
hint.driderlhints.3:
To gain access to the Toxic Bellows
you must activate 4 different triggers.
hint.plaguelhints.1:
The Javelin of Blinding
can be found in the Mountain Cavern.
hint.plaguelhints.2:
You must take the elevator down
to the lava flow to view your goal.
hint.plaguelhints.3:
Find the two shoot walls
that will lead you to the Javelin.
hint.yetilhints.1:
The Parchment of Fire can be found
in the Province Cemetery.
hint.yetilhints.2:
You must locate the pool of fire
to find the Parchment.
hint.yetilhints.3:
Find the three triggers to
Spin, Lower and Remove the flames.
hint.wraithlhints.1:
The Lantern of Revelation
has made its way to the Haunted Grounds
deep in the Dream Realm.
hint.wraithlhints.2:
When you hear the organ playing
you may see the light from the Lantern.
hint.wraithlhints.3:
You must reach the second floor
of the Haunted House
to gain access to the Lantern.
hint.lichlhints.1:
The Book of Protection can be found
aboard one of the airships
in the Sky Shipyard.
hint.lichlhints.2:
A prisoner on the airship
near the rear of the fleet
holds the Book.
hint.lichlhints.3:
The stern of the last ship.
holds the first trigger
that must be activated.
hint.skorne1lhints.1:
The Soul Savior has been located
in the Desecrated Temple.
hint.skorne1lhints.2:
Death may be found
preaching under the Soul Savior.
hint.skorne1lhints.3:
You must lower the final altar
to reach the Soul Savior.
hint.skorne2lhints.1:
There are no legendary items
that can help you defeat Skorne again.
hint.skorne2lhints.2:
Skorne is all powerful in the underworld.
No sacred items can help you.
hint.garmlhints.1: Garm is impervious to magical relics.
hint.garmlhints.2:
Only your strength, wisdom and powers
can help you defeat Garm.
hint.nobosslhint.1:
An item of Legend is not what you
Should be seeking at this time
hint.generalhints1.1:
Your precious food
can be spoiled
by the toxic green gas.
hint.generalhints1.2:
Be careful what you shoot.
Explosions can destroy
valuable items.
hint.generalhints1.3:
You may need to activate
hidden switches to proceed.
hint.generalhints1.4:
Never leave my tower
without a full turbo.
hint.generalhints1.5:
Find the secret door and
a beast within can be unleashed
by collecting all the coins.
hint.generalhints1.6:
I have placed scrolls
to help you in each realm.
hint.generalhints1.7:
Keys are more valuable
than junk and some fruits.
hint.generalhints1.8:
You must find enough crystals
of the appropriate color
to enter each realm.
hint.generalhints1.9:
Sections of my tower
can only be unlocked
by collecting all of the
proper golden icons.
hint.generalhints1.10:
You may trade your gold
for health, keys and weapons.
hint.generalhints1.11:
The power of invisibility
is useless against Skorne's
mighty guardians.
hint.generalhints1.12:
Powerups have a shorter duration
when facing Skorne's Guardians.
hint.generalhints1.13:
A less experienced hero
should not spend gold
on improving his attributes.
hint.generalhints1.14:
If a Runestone can not be
found, banish Skorne and I
can help show you the way.
hint.generalhints1.15:
The beast within each character
begins and ends
stronger in every way.
hint.generalhints1.16:
Be sure to vanquish
Golems and Generals,
as they may have valuables
in their possession.
hint.generalhints1.17:
I have more knowledge to tell
after you unlock more of my tower.
hint.generalhints2.1:
A chest with Death
can be turned from
sour to sweet by using magic.
hint.generalhints2.2:
Picking up a turbo powerup
when your meter is full will
waste its power.
hint.generalhints2.3:
While in my tower your powerups
will not be depleted.
hint.generalhints2.4:
You can double the duration
of a powerup by purchasing it twice.
hint.generalhints2.5:
Having spare keys can save you
both time and travel.
hint.generalhints2.7:
A level 25 hero will gain
new magic abilities.
The route backwards within a realm
may become blocked as you progress,
so leave nothing precious behind.
hint.generalhints2.8:
The location of items
may change when two or more
heroes enter a realm.
hint.generalhints2.9:
Eating food when your health is
nearly full may cause some of it
to be wasted.
hint.generalhints2.10:
I have more knowledge to tell
after you unlock more of my tower.
hint.generalhints3.1:
The stained glass window
must be restored to enter
the desecrated temple.
hint.generalhints3.2:
Twelve Runestones
will lead you to the underworld.
A thirteenth will lead you to Garm.
hint.generalhints3.3:
To speed your travel
within my tower.
Find the magic carpet.
hint.generalhints3.4:
At level 50, a hero's magic ability
grows much stronger.
hint.generalhints3.5:
A bridge now completes the travel
from east to west within my tower.
hint.generalhints3.6:
Experienced heroes can gain much
by increasing their attributes.
hint.generalhints3.7:
I have more knowledge to tell
after you unlock more of my tower.
hint.generalhints4.1:
A wise man carries a full key ring
into the Desecrated Temple.
hint.generalhints4.2:
Skorne is more powerful than magic.
Yours will be useless against him.
hint.generalhints4.3:
In the underworld,
your only nourishment
for your fight against Skorne
is held by the fire golems.
hint.generalhints4.4:
At level 75, your magic
will begin to heal you
and your comrades.
hint.generalhints4.5:
Once you become a legend
you should no longer
fear the black death.
hint.generalhints4.6:
I have no further knowledge
to assist you mighty hero.
help.chimera_speech.1:
You have defeated the fearsome Chimera
and recovered his shard.
help.dragon_speech.1:
You have defeated the mighty Dragon
and recovered his shard.
help.djinn_speech.1:
You have defeated the terrible Genie
and recovered his shard.
help.drider_speech.1:
You have defeated the vicious
Spider Queen and recovered her shard.
help.yeti_speech.1:
You have defeated the vicious
Yeti and recovered his shard.
help.pboss_speech.1:
You have defeated the vile
Plague Fiend and recovered his shard.
help.lich_speech.1:
You have defeated the horrifying
Lich and recovered his shard.
help.wraith_speech.1:
You have defeated the mysterious
Shadow Wraith and recovered his shard.
help.rune_phrase0.1:
You have not found any runestones
from this realm.
help.rune_phrase1.1:
You have found one runestone
from this realm.
help.rune_phrase1b.1:
You have found the one runestone
from this realm.
help.rune_phrase2.1:
You have found both runestones
from this realm.
help.skorne1_speech.2:
You have defeated the evil demon Skorne
and banished him to the Underworld.
help.skorne1_rune_yes.1:
I see you have found all 12 missing
Runestones.
help.skorne1_rune_yes.3:
Now, enter the Underworld and
destroy Skorne,
help.skorne1_rune_no.1: Your task however is not yet complete.
help.skorne1_rune_no.2:
You must gather the remaining
runestones in order to follow
help.skorne1_rune_no.3:
Skorne into the Underworld.
Only there can he be destroyed forever.
help.skorne1_rune_no.4: Search again and I will help you find them.
help.skorne2_speech.2:
The evil demon Skorne has been
Destroyed!
help.skorne2_speech.3:
He will never again threaten the
Eight Realms.
help.skorne2_speech.4:
Join me now in my tower to
celebrate this great victory!
help.garm2_speech.2:
Garm has been destroyed and his Evil
has been purged from the Realms!!
